family: opt-in gesture or gaze as local input
one_line: Local dwell-not-select; a sealed dwell class hashes to a refusal id; no clock is read and no target is activated; a completed look is not a click and not a decoded intention; unattested default.

hypothesis.observation: Public gaze and gesture products map a completed dwell or a tracked focus area to a selection or a render region.
hypothesis.claim: A sealed dwell class is a label a person types, not a sensor reading of looking.
hypothesis.inference: Hashing the class with a disconfirm line can record the refusal without activating a target.
hypothesis.disconfirm: A sealed human later attests a first-party sensor log that a named class was a measured dwell and that the page activated a target. This draft cannot produce that attestation.

confidence.note: Typed by the person. Not an accuracy score and not a measurement.
